# Torzon Market

> Torzon Market is a darknet marketplace providing secure access through Tor .onion mirrors and encrypted cryptocurrency transactions.

Torzon Market operates as a darknet marketplace accessible via the Tor network, offering secure trading infrastructure with emphasis on user privacy, cryptographic security, and anonymous transactions using Bitcoin and Monero.
